ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Выборка групп конвертов для групповой обработки
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT c.id AS contr_id, c.post_zip AS ind_to, c.post_str1 AS str_to1, c.post_str2 AS str_to2, c.post_str3 AS str_to3, c.post_str4 AS str_to4, c.post_str5 AS str_to5, c.post_str6 AS str_to6, c.special_notes AS prim, g.name AS group_name FROM counterparties c JOIN groups g ON c.group_id = g.id WHERE g.id = :GroupId AND c.is_active = TRUE AND c.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY c.name ASC;

SELECT c.id AS contr_id, c.post_zip AS ind_to, c.post_str1 AS str_to1, c.post_str2 AS str_to2, c.post_str3 AS str_to3, c.post_str4 AS str_to4, c.post_str5 AS str_to5, c.post_str6 AS str_to6, c.special_notes AS prim, g.name AS group_name FROM counterparties c JOIN groups g ON c.group_id = g.id WHERE g.id = :GroupId AND c.is_active = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.name ASC;
